question: What should come in the place of blank number 3?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Profits**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage states that by minimising dependency on costly inputs, farmers can save money and enhance their (3)__________.
 
• The most logical word here is "**Profits**", since saving money directly increases financial gains.
